title: Frenzy

inlines.v: FREN'ZY, noun [Latin phrenitis, Gr. from mind, which is from moving, rushing. See Frantic.] Madness; distraction; rage; or any violent agitation of the mind approaching to distraction. All else is towering frenzy and distraction.
